title: Builder Extended Rate Lock Relock Pricing — Lapse Day Adjustment
content:
On a relock of an expired Builder Extended Rate Lock, the number of days the lock has stood expired adds percentage points to the relock fee percent.

**Rule.** Lapse days are counted with the expired date on record as day one and the relock date as the last day counted. A relock on lapse day 15 or later adds 0.125 percentage points to the relock fee percent; a relock on lapse day 8 up to the day before lapse day 15 adds 0.0625 percentage points; a relock on an earlier lapse day adds nothing. The points are added to the relock fee percent before that percent is applied to the loan amount on the lock.

## Adjustment by lapse day

| Lapse day of the relock | Added to the relock fee percent |
|---|---|
| 1 through 7 | nothing |
| 8 through 14 | 0.0625 percentage points |
| 15 or later | 0.125 percentage points |

## Boundary days

- Lapse day 7 adds nothing; lapse day 8 adds 0.0625.
- Lapse day 14 adds 0.0625; lapse day 15 adds 0.125.

## Counting example (hypothetical dates)

A lock with an expired date of 10 March on record: a relock written on 10 March is on lapse day 1; on 16 March, lapse day 7; on 17 March, lapse day 8; on 23 March, lapse day 14; on 24 March, lapse day 15. The relock date is the date the relock is written.

## Effect example (hypothetical inputs)

A relock fee percent of 0.375 on a relock written on lapse day 9 becomes 0.4375 before it is applied to the loan amount.
